The bike has a red and black frame, front suspension forks, a front basket, and a rear fender.
The seat and handlebars are also wrapped in plastic.
Photo 0 shows the bike outdoors on a paved surface, with refrigerators and a workshop in the background.
Photo 1 shows the bike indoors or in a covered area, leaning against a wall, with another bicycle partially visible behind it.
No brand or model name is visible on the frame or any part of the bike in either photo.
The bike appears to be in new or near-new condition, but the wrapping suggests it is being sold as used or imported.
